subject: Reserved capacity scenarios, optional hedge and discount tiers - TerraAI
messages:
From: Emma Cole <emma@terraai.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
Cc: procurement@terraai.com
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Reserved capacity ask + sensitivity to GPU pricing

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — team was impressed with the latency profiles. We are preparing the procurement packet for a committed reserved capacity purchase and need to understand two things before we go to our finance committee next week:  

1) A simple set of sizing scenarios (12 / 24 / 36 month commit) showing cost per token and total committed spend assuming current GPU pricing and a +20% GPU cost shock.
2) What discount tiers Redwood can offer at each commit tenor and the approval path for any uplift beyond the standard published discount.

Can you send a short matrix and any assumptions? We need something we can drop into the packet (one slide).

Appreciate it — Emma
Emma Cole
Head of Platform Partnerships, TerraAI
[Attachment: RFP_TerraAI_12-24-36.pdf (pdf, 210 KB)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
To: Emma Cole <emma@terraai.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reserved capacity ask + sensitivity to GPU pricing

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear ask. Drafted a short matrix and three-sizing scenarios attached; included a base case (current GPU spot/fixed blended price), a conservative case (+10% GPU delta) and a stress case (+20% GPU delta) with the corresponding pass-through and discount impacts.

Quick highlights:
- For 12m commit we can offer up to 15% list discount on compute and a modest usage credit structure; economics degrade fastest under the +20% scenario.
- For 24m commit, we can extend 22% discount with a requirement for a non-cancellable minimum monthly floor.
- For 36m, we can discuss up to 30% but that requires exec approval and a 60% prepayment option or a revenue share fallback (see notes).

I attached a capacity model and a one-page term summary suitable for your packet. The model includes a column that applies a simple GPU cost shock sensitivity and reruns per-token cost and total spend.

Attachments: [terraai_capacity_model.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78 KB)], [terraai_term_summary.pdf (pdf, 42 KB)]

Please loop in procurement and tell me which tenor you want me to route for pricing approval. If you want, I can also produce a one-slide visual for your finance committee.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 07:38:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Reserved capacity ask + sensitivity to GPU pricing

Thanks for the model, Jonas — good work. A few operational / approval notes from Sales Ops & Finance:  

1) Discount guardrails (standard): 12m up to 15% — Sales rep sign-off; 24m up to 22% — requires Sales Ops review and Revenue Ops alignment; 36m 25%+ — requires SVP approval + legal to add prepayment or revenue-share fallback language.

2) Hedging language: we can offer an optional GPU-cost pass-through clause tied to public cloud GPU index (quarterly reset) OR a fixed-price hedge that reduces unit price volatility in exchange for an additional 6% fee on total commit (hedge premium). We should present both to the customer as choices.

3) Risk mitigations: suggest adding a phased provisioning schedule (30/40/30) to lower upfront utilization risk and include an escape clause if third-party GPU hardware spot prices rise >35% across two consecutive quarters. That escape triggers a renegotiation, not an immediate unwind.

4) Approvals path: If TerraAI requests >25% discount or any novel hedge/refund constructs, route to Sean for discretionary approval. For pricing shocks >20% we will escalate to Finance for contingency credits.

If you want me to draft the approval matrix language for the one-pager, say the word and I’ll slot in the exact lines and approvers.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Reserved capacity ask + sensitivity to GPU pricing

Folks — reviewed Kim's notes + the spreadsheet Jon attached. I approve the following discretionary levers for TerraAI, conditional on legal and finance sign-off:  

- Approve up to 30% discount for a 36-month commitment if customer opts for either 60% prepayment OR a 3-tier revenue-share fallback (starts after year 2) and is willing to accept an indexed GPU-cost pass-through up to a 10% band.
- Approve the hedge premium option (fixed-price hedge) as an optional add-on at +6% to the committed spend.

Kim: please prepare the approval memo and attach the exact approver signatures (Finance lead + Legal GC) so we can fast-track the quote. Jonas: send the one-slide summary back to Emma with the two hedge options and the final approval language.

SG
Sean Gallagher
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
